form:FormGroup.label: Max Spans Per Trace
form:FormGroup.helpText: The most spans stored for a single trace, e.g. 100k. Extra spans are dropped and the trace is marked as truncated. Enter 0 for no limit. Default is 100,000.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Number, e.g. 100k. 0 means no limit. Default is 100,000.
